title: Moment of Inertia of a Uniform Circular Disk
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the moment of inertia I_z of a uniform circular disk of radius R = 2 and constant density delta = 3.

steps.title: Compute Total Mass
steps.explanation: Multiply density by area of disk.

steps.title: Set Up Polar Moment of Inertia Integral
steps.mathExpression: I_z = \iint_D r^2 \delta \, dA = 3 \int_0^{2\pi} d\theta \int_0^2 r^3 \, dr = 3(2\pi) \left[ \frac{r^4}{4} \right]_0^2 = 6\pi \left(\frac{16}{4}\right) = 24\pi
steps.explanation: Integrate r^2 dm = r^2 (3 r dr dtheta).
